_comment: THE COACH EXAM'S SCOREBOARD. Written by scripts/grade-coach-exam.ts and read by scripts/test-coach-exam-fresh.ts, which fails the sweep when the coach on disk no longer matches the coach these scores describe. Tracked in git so the history survives, the same as quality-report.txt.
_baselinePending: The exam is built, its rubric is written and its hard rules are fixture-tested — but no conversation has been played against the real model yet, because that needs credentials a cloud session does not have. Until the first run, 'the coach gives good advice' is still asserted rather than known. The first real run replaces this whole file.
_floor: Not set until the first real run. test:quality's 7.2 was chosen against measured scores rather than picked in advance; this one is proposed to Ashley from the first run's numbers and enforced from the run after that.
